name: example-motion-claude-motion-reel
title: Claude Motion Reel
description: A Claude motion design showreel with kinetic typography, easing experiments, geometric morphs, Truchet patterns and a rotating vertex mesh.

description_i18n.en: A Claude motion design showreel with kinetic typography, easing experiments, geometric morphs, Truchet patterns and a rotating vertex mesh.
description_i18n.zh-CN: Claude 动态设计作品集，用字形伸缩、六种缓动、几何变形、弧线纹样与旋转网格展示动效能力。

query.en: Create a 15-second motion design showreel for {{brand}}, with the descriptor {{role}} and the small fixed top label {{reelLabel}}, dated {{reelYear}}. Use {{coral}} coral, {{blue}} electric blue, {{paper}} warm paper, {{ink}} near black and {{lime}} neon yellow. Start on black: a red point expands into twelve unequal rounded rays with concentric circles, a dotted drafting grid and the orbiting text {{orbitText}}. Cut to coral, a thin numbered rule above a huge {{brand}}; each letter stretches horizontally in sequence, then the italic {{role}} appears below. On warm paper introduce “{{easingTitle}}”, six numbered lanes labelled linear, ease-in-out, expo-out, back-out, elastic and bounce; black, blue and red dots traverse identical distances with their curve thumbnails, ticks, squash and trails. Switch to blue: a warm white circle morphs into a triangle, a five-point star and a square while twelve smaller shapes orbit and coral outlines trail the rotation. On black spread a dense field of quarter-circle Truchet tiles, transforming connected cream loops into disconnected coral arcs in three waves. Pull those tiles away to reveal a perspective grid of 576 white and red vertices, rolling into a sphere and then a rotating torus. Rapidly cut across the words {{easeWord}}, {{inWord}}, {{easeWord}}, {{outWord}}, {{neverWord}}, a five-row repeating {{neverWord}} wall, and finally {{linearWord}} with a coral period; vary the backgrounds and use stretched glyphs and motion trails, then zoom through the last letter. Finish on coral: the black asterisk bursts and moves left, the image {{wordmark}} reveals as the final brand wordmark, {{role}} sits underneath in italic, then a thin rule, {{footer}}, a pulsing availability dot and {{availability}}. Keep the four corner registration marks, tiny chapter names, 60 FPS timecode, 128 BPM beat squares, eight-bar counter and lower progress line throughout.
query.zh-CN: 为 {{brand}} 制作约 15 秒的动态设计作品集，职业描述为 {{role}}，固定左上眉题为 {{reelLabel}}，年份为 {{reelYear}}。使用 {{coral}} 珊瑚红、{{blue}} 电光蓝、{{paper}} 暖纸白、{{ink}} 墨黑和 {{lime}} 荧光黄。黑底开场，红点伸成十二根不等长圆头射线，环线与点阵制图网格向外扩散，{{orbitText}} 环绕星芒旋转；切入珊瑚红，编号横线下的巨幅 {{brand}} 逐字横向伸缩，下方浮现斜体 {{role}}。接着在暖白底显示“{{easingTitle}}”，六行分别标注 linear、ease-in-out、expo-out、back-out、elastic、bounce，黑蓝红圆点按各自曲线穿过相同长度的跑道，附曲线缩略图、刻度、挤压和残影。切到蓝底，米白圆形依次变成三角、五角星与方形，十二个小形状绕行，红色轮廓追随旋转。黑底随后铺满四分之一圆弧拼接的 Truchet 纹样，三次波动让连贯的米白环线转为散开的红弧；纹样退开，576 个白红顶点构成透视网格，卷成球体并转为旋转环面。连续快切 {{easeWord}}、{{inWord}}、{{easeWord}}、{{outWord}}、{{neverWord}}、五行重复的 {{neverWord}} 字墙，以及带红色句点的 {{linearWord}}，配合换底色、字形拉伸和运动拖影，最后穿过放大的末字。结尾回到红底，黑色星芒爆开移向左侧，图片 {{wordmark}} 揭示为片尾品牌字标，下方是斜体 {{role}}、细横线、{{footer}}、呼吸状态灯和 {{availability}}。全片保留四角定位线、小号章节名、60 FPS 时码、128 BPM 节拍方格、八小节计数和底部进度线。
